text:
Alice K: Heads up — Orion Systems just uploaded a revised master services agreement for the Dedicated GPU racks. Procurement flagged a new indemnity + supplier audit clause that Legal says is a no-go. This is blocking the onboarding and the reserved capacity commit. Any quick ideas?

Jordan P: cc @Marta L — can Legal weigh in? Also tagging @Devon S to loop BD. Do we have a temporary workaround so the customer onboarding isn't stalled? :grimacing:

Marta L: Saw this. Clause is broad — allows supplier to "access systems and data" for audits with no limits. We can't accept remote code access or unlimited audit scope. Propose we redline to: 1) audit limited to facility/security controls, 2) 30-day notice, 3) no remote execution or access to customer data/algorithms. I'll draft redline.

Devon S: Thanks Marta. I'll ask Orion BD for a scope-limited audit and push for mutual audit language. If they won't budge, can we do a staging onboarding under a temporary contract?

infra-oncall: Ops input — we can provision an isolated VPC + air-gapped subnet for initial capacity so audit risk is reduced. Would still need contractual limits though.

Jordan P: Procurement update: vendor portal shows a draft PO but it won't route until the MSA is signed. procurement-bot created draft PO 6421.

procurement-bot: "PO 6421 (draft) created for Orion Systems — awaiting MSA signature and billing code assignment."

Alice K: Marta — can you drop the redline into the vendor portal by EOD? If Orion accepts the limited scope we can proceed with the reserved pool provisioning and kick off migrations. If they refuse, we'll need an exec-level call.

Marta L: On it. I'll submit redline + a short rationale note and request a negotiated phone call. Draft language I'll add to portal:```
Audit scope limited to physical/security controls; no access to customer code, models, or raw data; 30-day prior notice required; audits to be onsite or via mutually agreed attestation; no remote execution rights.
```

Devon S: I'll schedule BD -> Orion legal for tomorrow AM and flag for AE/AM to pause customer comms until we have a path.

Jordan P: Also adding a fallback — Ops to estimate cost for isolated staging machines (1-week) so we can buy breathing room if needed.

Alice K: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Please update thread when portal redline submitted or vendor responds. :thumbsup:
